settings.title: Zigbee Traffic
settings.intro: One row per physical device with availability tracking. Multi-gang devices are counted once through their main device.
settings.no_devices: No devices with availability tracking yet.
settings.reset_confirmation: Reset the message statistics for all devices? This cannot be undone.
settings.footnote: "Frames" are raw Zigbee messages (mains-powered devices). "Activity" represents explicit callbacks from battery/sleepy sensors. Data is persisted at most once every five minutes.
settings.reset_rejoins_confirmation: Reset the rejoin counters for all devices? This cannot be undone.
settings.rejoin_footnote: A rejoin is detected from a paired 0xFC11 + 0x0006 boot-dump pattern right after the device reconnects — see MINI-ZBD/ZBMINIR2 device.js.
